rule: Every tracked file and folder name is lowercase snake_case: segments of [a-z0-9_] joined by dots for extensions. README.md is the one deliberate exception.

keep_basenames.Cargo.toml: Cargo only reads this exact name
keep_basenames.Cargo.lock: Cargo only reads this exact name
keep_basenames.SKILL.md: the Agent Skills format requires this exact name
keep_basenames.AGENTS.md: agent tools look for this exact name
keep_basenames.CLAUDE.md: Claude Code looks for this exact name
keep_basenames.lean-toolchain: elan only reads this exact name
keep_basenames.lake-manifest.json: Lake only reads this exact name
keep_basenames.lakefile.lean: Lake only reads this exact name
keep_basenames.lakefile.toml: Lake only reads this exact name
keep_basenames.FUNDING.yml: GitHub only reads this exact name
keep_basenames.CODEOWNERS: GitHub only reads this exact name
keep_basenames.LICENSE: GitHub licence detection, pyproject license = { file = "LICENSE" } and the pfp-cli release job copy this exact name
keep_basenames.LICENSE-CODE: licence file convention; papers publication manifests pin it by name
keep_basenames.NOTICE: Apache NOTICE convention; tools look for this exact name
keep_basenames.GEMINI.md: Gemini CLI reads this exact name, like CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md
keep_basenames.Project.toml: Julia Pkg only reads this exact name
keep_basenames.Manifest.toml: Julia Pkg only reads this exact name
keep_basenames.JuliaProject.toml: Julia Pkg only reads this exact name
keep_basenames.block-dangerous-git.sh: users register this hook by path in their Claude Code settings; a rename silently turns the guard off
keep_basenames.SCORING.md: the acceptance-floor spec; governed sources, contract score files, .gitattributes and the source repository's provenance records cite this exact name, so a rename re-pins every governed source that mentions it

keep_globs.**/*.lean: Lean module names are imports; renaming them rewrites every import and proof
keep_globs.csharp/**: .NET project, namespace and assembly names follow PascalCase
keep_globs.operads/skills/*: a skill folder must match the hyphenated name in its SKILL.md
keep_globs.benchmarks/industry_replacement/industry: a skill folder must match the hyphenated name in its SKILL.md
keep_globs.atlas/archive/**: papers keep their bytes, and their READMEs, manifests and .sha256 files name these files exactly
keep_globs.dag/**: hash-pinned records and generated inventories (dag/.gitattributes sets * -text); build_dags.py writes several names literally
keep_globs.governance/evidence/**: governance/tools/evidence.py and mutation.py build these names from the evidence name, and contract score files cite them by path and sha256
keep_globs.pfp/infrastructure/tower_evidence/**: frozen level-engine and reach evidence: v1 is a preserved snapshot pinned by sha256, v2 file names are built from record tags (L000, T072) that content digests carry
keep_globs.pfp/infrastructure/tower_research/level_: adapter names are built from record tags (f"L{level:03d}"), and payload/*/RESTATEMENT.md and lifts/*/CLASS.json are in the hashed harness source list behind every bundle and receipt digest
keep_globs.pfp/infrastructure/tower_research/reach/: preserved v1 reach data; folder names are carrier keys stored in ledger.jsonl and hashed into numbers.json
keep_globs.pfp/tests/level_engine/reach_draft/*: CHECKER_REL is embedded in receipt source paths and in the gate.py exclude regex
keep_globs.pfp/infrastructure/yaml/normal_forms/*: a normal-form file name is its id (index.yaml lists nf.operational.schema-totality); signed-off receipts cite planned-tests*.md
keep_globs.ops/governance/contracts/level_engine/**: governance_path("PINS.json") looks the pin file up by bare name, and the historical copies must match
keep_globs.operads/catalog/contracts/v1/lessons/*: typed_contract_compiler.py refuses a lesson whose file stem differs from its hyphenated skill_id
keep_globs.operads/catalog/contracts/v1/instruction: file stem equals the hyphenated skill_id, read by computed name
keep_globs.operads/receipts/**: frozen receipts: .gitattributes sets -text and verification.json pins each file by path and sha256
keep_globs.operads/skills/ooutwire/prompt-civilizat: left to the deletions job; do not rename a folder that is being deleted
keep_globs.eis/antiskills/ooutwire/**: file names carry the hyphenated spec ids; Rust include_bytes! paths and profile and registry digests depend on them
keep_globs.eis/antiskills/admitted/**: admitted registry and human decisions keyed by the hyphenated spec ids
keep_globs.pfp_lab/core/packs/*.json: a pack file name is its public hyphenated pack id; contracts.py loads f"{pack_id}.json"
keep_globs.code/rust/ppo/rust_crates/RECEIPT.txt: hash-pinned receipt; Rust builds the path literally and verify_receipt_text checks it
keep_globs.workflows/wf*/pilots/pilot_*/**: pilot run records; the live runner builds these file names from model ids and pfp/tests/test_mode_trials.py builds capsule paths by name
keep_globs.workflows/library/evidence/**: raw provider captures indexed by raw_manifest.json and wiki/Workflow-Results.md by run id
keep_globs.workflows/library/pilot_estate/evidence/: custody evidence; sibling records and test_paper021_capture_custody.py name these files
keep_globs.workflows/wf22_certified_cost_ladder/pil: campaign evidence named in ledgers, collation.json and wiki/Workflow-Results.md
keep_globs.education/**/media/images/**/*_ManimCE_*: Manim writes this name from the scene class on every render
keep_globs.workflows/**/judge_packet/**: case and mutation files are named by their ids; generate_mutations.py and generate_cases.py write these names, the ids repeat inside the files, and tests slice sorted globs, so lowercasing changes which files they pick
keep_globs.workflows/**/participant_packet/examples: example data files named by their ids, listed by the packet text
keep_globs.pilots/**: historical pilot estate awaiting deletion; not renamed or rewritten
keep_globs.workflows/*/pilots/evidence/**: raw captured provider requests and replies from pilot runs, named by run id

frozen_bundle_note: A folder holding MANIFEST.sha256, SHA256SUMS, SHA256.json or manifest.json is a hash-pinned bundle. Nothing inside it is renamed, so the manifest keeps matching.

rewrite_exclude_globs.atlas/archive/**: papers keep their content byte for byte
rewrite_exclude_globs.dag/**: hash-pinned records and generated inventories; regenerate them with their own tools instead
rewrite_exclude_globs.governance/evidence/**: evidence records are hashed by the score files that cite them
rewrite_exclude_globs.pfp/tests/normal_forms/json/**: signed-off receipts cite paths as history
rewrite_exclude_globs.workflows/wf50_repo_hygiene/**: the tool and its tests hold old names as test data
rewrite_exclude_globs.pilots/**: historical pilot estate awaiting deletion; not renamed or rewritten
rewrite_exclude_globs.workflows/*/pilots/evidence/**: raw captured provider requests and replies from pilot runs
rewrite_exclude_globs.workflows/wf*/pilots/pilot_*/**: pilot run records; their links name files in the source repository at capture time
rewrite_exclude_globs.workflows/library/validation.json: dated validation record; its paths and sha256 values are history
rewrite_exclude_globs.workflows/library/migration_validation.j: dated migration validation record; its paths and sha256 values are history
rewrite_exclude_globs.workflows/**/judge_packet/**/*.py: judge code is pinned by sha256 in the judge manifests; its docstrings keep the names it was certified with
